title: Britt Baker vs. Thunder Rosa
summary: A violent personal rivalry grows from Lights Out into a championship chase and a steel-cage payoff.

chapters.title: Lights Out main event
chapters.result: Rosa defeats Baker in an unsanctioned Lights Out match.
chapters.context: Their rivalry headlines Dynamite in a landmark women’s main event.

chapters.title: Baker survives the title challenge
chapters.result: Baker retains the women’s world title against Rosa.
chapters.context: Outside assistance leaves Rosa seeking another opportunity.

chapters.title: Rosa wins inside the cage
chapters.result: Rosa defeats Baker for the championship in a steel cage.
chapters.context: The cage rematch finally delivers Rosa the title.
